items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: Harrison Barnes told us about that. I remember him saying that they'd meet at these parades...

ctx.x: And he used to play them. My granddad used to play them. Harrison Barnes told us about that. I remember him saying that they'd meet at these parades that start at the canal and the river. And I remember him saying that it would be so cold sometimes that the valves would freeze. It would freeze on the horns and water would get watered in them. I remember him saying that.
And he already played the St. Patrick's Day parade.
